shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null | head -50
find /workspace/app /workspace/lib /workspace/__agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "---" && cat /workspace/next.config.ts
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -rl "cacheComponents" . | head -30
cat /workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs
sed -n '1,120p' 01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md
cd /workspace && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40
tail -5 app/product/page.tsx | cat -A | tail -5
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

find .next -path '*product*' -name '*.html' 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- shell HTML ---"; for f in $(find .next -path '*product*' -name '*.html' 2>/dev/null); do echo "== $f"; grep -o 'Premium Widget\|Checking availability\|in stock\|Price:' "$f" | sort -u; done
(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:3111/ 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 0.5; done; echo "server up"

echo "=== full response 1 ===" && curl -s http://localhost:3111/product | grep -o 'Premium Widget\|Checking availability\|[0-9]* in stock\|Price: \$[0-9.]*' | sort -u; echo; echo "=== full response 2 (freshness check) ===" && curl -s http://localhost:3111/product | grep -o '[0-9]* in stock\|Price: \$[0-9.]*' | sort -u

curl -s http://localhost:3111/product | grep -o '

[^<]*[^<]*[^<]*

\|

[^<]*in stock[^<]*

\|

Price[^!]*[^<]*

' | head; echo "=== raw tail ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/product | tr '>' '>\n' | grep -n -A3 -B1 'in stock\|Price' | head -30

pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; (npx next dev -p 3122 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:3122/ 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 0.5; done; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3122/product; sleep 4; echo "=== dev log ==="; cat /tmp/dev.log
cat /tmp/dev.log 2>/dev/null | tail -40; echo "=== exit ==="

nohup npx next dev -p 3133 > /tmp/dev2.log 2>&1 & echo started; sleep 12; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "home:%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3133/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "product:%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3133/product; sleep 5; echo "=== dev log ==="; cat /tmp/dev2.log

cp /tmp/fixed-page.tsx app/product/page.tsx && sleep 3; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "product(fixed):%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3133/product; sleep 5; echo "=== dev log since ==="; tail -6 /tmp/dev2.log

pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo "=== git status ===" && git status --short && echo && echo "=== diff: tracked ===" && git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json
git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig/package diff ==="; git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json | cat
cat .gitignore; echo "=== AGENTS.md now ==="; cat AGENTS.md
git diff -- app/product/page.tsx | cat
